boundaries: Counts physical cards in the specified owner discard pile, not Energy units or field Pokemon.
Named attacks use the discarded printed attack identifier; Pokemon names are exact canonical names with explicit unions, never substring matches.
Typed Pokemon use printed types, counting dual types once; legacy profiles provide primary type when tags are absent.
Basic Energy type filters require the Basic Energy identity; Special Energy never inherits its former attached type.
Count limits cap the variable damage portion, preserving any printed base damage.
Mandatory recovery runs after damage and retains existing strict recovery category schema.
Unrecognized companion abilities, attacks or structural fields keep the whole card unsupported.
